notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0 - New game mode available
notes.notes:
That’s right! As the title of this update says, there’s a brand new way to play [b]Polygon War[/b].

Now, when selecting the difficulty, you can decide whether to face the challenge in Automatic Mode, [i]the original[/i], or in Manual Mode, [i]the new one[/i].

What’s this new mode about?

As the name suggests, you’ll be able to control the turret at all times. If you thought the turret didn’t aim well in Auto Mode… now you can see for yourself. It’s not just about aiming, you’ll also have to shoot. However, there’s a catch: enemies have twice as much health in this mode. Enjoy [b]Polygon War[/b] your own way.

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Controller support has been improved for a better experience. On PlayStation controllers, shooting is now done with the [i][b]Square[/b][/i] button, while on Xbox controllers it’s the [i][b]X[/b][/i].
[*] To change the game speed, you can now use [i][b]Triangle[/b][/i] or [i][b]Y[/b][/i], respectively.
[*] The game version is now displayed in the main menu.
[/list]

We’re working hard to provide the best possible experience, and one of the best ways to achieve that is by listening to our players. Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2 - Bug fix and minor improvement to the UI
notes.notes:
[u][b]Bug fix:[/b][/u]

Resolved an issue where end-of-game data failed to display correctly if the session was closed and later resumed from a save point.


[u][b]Minor improvement:[/b][/u]

Shop modifiers in the turret selector now highlight bonuses with different colors based on their value.

We're working on the game to give you the best possible experience.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1 - Hotfixes and minor improvements
notes.notes:
[u][b]Minor improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Now the shopkeeper robot displays the description of the selected item.
[*] Now the selected speed of the game is saved when you exit a current run.
[*] Big difficulty adjustments on Infinite Mode,  the difficulty ramp-up is focused now about the difficulty of the enemies rather and the quantity.
[*] Some texts are now replaced with icons for better accessibility and clarity.
[*] Achievements are now obtainable whilst playing infinite mode.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] [i]"Hyperstress"[/i] damage is correctly updated now.
[*] [i]"Free Healing"[/i] now changes correctly the healing prices on purchase.
[/list]
